senses.gloss:
Rauraki
--Putrasvīkāravidhi. Mysore N. D. III. 8693. Extr. IV. A. p.. 661-62.

Raurava
a teacher of Śaiva doctrine, q. by Abhinavagupta in Īśvarapratyāsattivimarśinī.

Rauravatantra
or Rauravāgama. See below Rauravāgama.

Rauravanarakasūtra
q. by Nāgārjuna, in his Daśabhūmivibhāṣāśāstra; title restored by R. Kimura.
See IHQ. III. p. 416.

Rauravavārtika
or Vārttika.
--name of C.. on the Rauravāgama. See below the text. [Page294-b]

Rauravasaṅgraha
a. epitome of the Raurava. q. in Tantrāloka Vol. I. Kas. Texts 29. p.. 40-41. Mysore N. D. XII. 40811. Extr. p. 45.

Rauravasūtrasaṅgraha
śai.. Mysore I. p. 544. Mysore N. D. XII. 40811. Extr. Śai. App. p. 45. XV. 45610. Extr. p.. 119-120.

Rauravāgama
or Rauravatantra. śai.. Ref. to a. one of the 28 Śaivāgamas in Kāraṇagama, IO. 6113.
See list in Kāmika.
Pt.. MLBD. Delhi, 1988.
--C. Vārttika. q. by Abhinava in Tantrāloka, Vol. V. Kas. Texts. 35. p. 132.
